description: Known-answer vectors of the caller-webhook signature, specs/pipelex-caller-webhooks.md. Every signature was produced by the Standard Webhooks reference library for Python (PyPI standardwebhooks) and is checked against it by tests/caller_webhooks/test_signature_vectors.py. Each body is the exact text of a call, and what is signed is its UTF-8 encoding: a \u escape in this file stands for the character itself, which the body carries as raw UTF-8. Timestamps and receiver_clock are Unix seconds. The secrets are synthetic: 32 consecutive byte values, base64-encoded after whsec_.

signing.name: failed_run
signing.description: A failed run's first attempt under one secret: the run passed its time limit, and data carries its problem in the caller view.

signing.name: rotation
signing.description: A completed run's second attempt during a rotation: one signature per live secret, the current secret's first, separated by one space.

signing.name: non_ascii_body
signing.description: A failed run whose problem names a file and a function with non-ASCII characters, sent as raw UTF-8 rather than JSON escapes, so the signature covers the UTF-8 bytes of the body.
